correctness.rationale: For n>=5 the signed local difference formula is exact. All letters participating in a local change remain visible in its coordinate support, verified exhaustively after relabeling to at most six abstract symbols. Thus any possible collision transfers to that finite instance; the exhaustive certificate has exactly seven collision templates, six with two distinct letters and one with three. Boundary-type differences are disjoint from each other and from interior types by the same finite-support argument. Orbit counts yield I_q=q(q-1)(q^4-q-4), plus 4(q-1). An order-five de Bruijn sequence realizes all contexts and four boundary types at length q^5+4; padding preserves coverage. Direct full-profile calculations independently verify witnesses and selected exhaustive small-word domains.

value.rationale: The precise count of distinct one-substitution trigram-multiplicity observations measures loss of distinguishability of a natural q-ary sequencing/profile-readout channel. Its seven nonobvious collision templates give structural rather than routine information. The closed form applies to all q and is sharp at lengths within O(q^2) of a universal lower bound, offering exact error-ball-size information unavailable from generic edit-coding existence bounds.
